enchantments.tooltip: Arcane Casting Dexterity: This ability reduces the arcane spell failure chance by -10%.
Blurry: Equipping this item causes you to become slightly blurry. Attacks from enemies have a 20% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Intelligence +11: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +11 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Magical Efficiency 10%: You take a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of your spells.
